name: Numata Youko
source:
She wants to be a simple "[URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_street_fashion#Mori_girl]mori girl[/URL]". She was a cute girl loved by everyone. It's unfortunate that her friends framed Nonomiya to protect her. Thanks to Higanbana's chance, she was able to rest in peace, and now she's attending school in paradise.

Sometimes, it seems she comes back as a ghost and mingles among her former classmates. Nomiya wouldn't admit it, but it's clear he really liked her.

[Based on the English translation of her unlockable profile.]
